Answer: A
Reason: The initial chest X-ray (Figure 1a) shows a large left-sided mediastinal mass with significant opacification and mediastinal shift to the left, consistent with volume loss/collapse. The post-treatment image (Figure 1b) demonstrates marked resolution of the mass, normalization of the mediastinal position (reduced shift), and re-aeration of the left lung fields, indicating re-expansion.
